purpose: Replace rejected attempt-01 half-close caps with visibly progressive V9-derived compressed-eye components for a natural synchronized blink transition.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole image reference for the fixed black vertical oval eye identity, scale, spacing and rounded ink weight

reference_policy: Use only the locked V9 source as image reference. Do not use V44 or V45 rejected blink art as an image-generation reference.

blink_contract.pairing: matched mirrored left/right components on the V9 eye anchors
blink_contract.stages: open base V9 oval -> rounded compressed oval half-close -> short rounded closed stroke -> rounded compressed oval half-open -> open base V9 oval
blink_contract.half_close_shape: clearly oval with curved top and bottom, approximately 45-60 percent of the V9 open-eye height; never a flat-top or flat-bottom cap
blink_contract.half_open_shape: same V9 oval identity and rounded construction, visibly between closed and open in height; never a cap
blink_contract.native_target: each component fits the original eye footprint at 200x200 and contains no other facial feature

native_review_gate.symmetry: each left/right stage pair mirror difference <=2 black pixels
native_review_gate.stage_separation: both compressed-oval stages have curved top and bottom and are visibly distinct from the short closed stroke at native 200x200
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject caps, eyelid-only marks, changed eye grammar, lashes, winks, sleep eyes, face art, text, label, grid, border, device frame or any non-eye component
